kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نندمر (form VII)
# نَنْدَمِرُ (nandamiru) /nan.da.mi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْدَمَرَ (indamara)
# نَنْدَمِرَ (nandamira) /nan.da.mi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَمَرَ (indamara)
# نَنْدَمِرْ (nandamir) /nan.da.mir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْدَمَرَ (indamara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
